posts.title: Booking Nils Mango
posts.description: I'm an electronic music producer and live performer based in Biel/Bienne, Switzerland. I make live electronic music, shaped in the moment. My sets are solo and collective open-ended musical experiments, built and reshaped in real time. I work with rhythms, melodies, loops, samples and whatever else feels right in the moment.
